$comment: Hand-authored. Which OWASP GenAI source lists an AI Bill of Materials should list as CANDIDATE risks for a model, and which frameworks it should show controls from by default. Read by AIBOM tools together with data/exports/aibom-index.json. See docs/AIBOM_INTEGRATION.md.
status_note: Which risks apply to a model is security judgment (C4). These rules are deliberately coarse: a profile adds a whole source list, never a single entry, and a tool must label every result 'candidate — not assessed'. A model page alone cannot show whether a deployment is agentic or uses retrieval, so every profile except llm is opt-in.

profiles.description: A generative language model. Applied by default when the model's task is a text-generation task.
The model is deployed as, or inside, an agent that plans and calls tools. Opt-in: the user states it.
The deployment retrieves from, or the model is trained or fine-tuned on, organisational data (RAG, fine-tuning, training pipelines). Opt-in: the user states it.
The deployment loads agent skills or plugins from a registry. Opt-in: the user states it.

default_frameworks.$comment: The verified core ratified in #99 (2026-11-25); MITRE ATLAS joined when its registry re-sync (#434) landed. A tool may let the user choose any framework in the index; these are shown when the user chooses none.
